summary: PR Checks runs the frontend's eslint (--max-warnings=0), tsc, vitest and next build as the Frontend Checks job; run 38667285857 on PR #1057 passed it (665 tests), and the deliberate break in run 38668088048 failed all four steps, each reported. The 22 failing tests had five causes, none in product code (Vitest 4 constructor mocks, stale auth tests, a mock missing getState, a stub applied after module load). eslint went from 29 errors and 5 warnings to 0 and 0 by fixing code, with two targeted disables; three real defects fixed with tests that fail on the old code (OAuth callback under StrictMode, price-chart tooltip resolution, delayed aria-live freshness announcement). The configs-page sparkline, which drew random points, is removed; five never-imported modules are deleted. make validate passes 8 of 8 blocking stages; make test-unit passes 4259 of 4259. Spec: specs/1405-frontend-ci-gate/spec.md.
for_the_board: Remove #17 from cards/goal.json: priority item 2 and the READY list.

After landing, make 'Frontend Checks' a required status check on main (operator approved, recorded in cards/17.json runConfiguration): gh api -X POST repos/traylorre/sentiment-analyzer-gsk/branches/main/protection/required_status_checks/contexts -f 'contexts[]=Frontend Checks'. Not done before landing because main's workflow does not define the job yet, so every open PR would wait on it.
After landing, close draft PR #1057 and delete its branch: gh pr close 1057 --delete-branch; then rm -rf /tmp/card17-clone and git branch -D card-17-frontend-ci in the root checkout.

Rank first after #17, as Helios said: cards/NEW-card-17-pre-push-flips-core-bare.json. A push from any linked worktree sets core.bare=true in the shared repository (twice in this run); until it lands, push only from a standalone clone or the root checkout.

Number and place: cards/NEW-card-17-branch-collision-claim-ref.json (the collision pre-push hook refuses every push from a card worktree), cards/NEW-card-17-pip-audit-ignore-expired.json and cards/NEW-card-17-detect-secrets-closed-cards.json (two non-required PR Checks jobs red on every main push), cards/NEW-card-17-alert-form-reset-on-rerender.json and cards/NEW-card-17-session-expiry-message-lost.json (frontend defects found while refactoring; both carry an unmeasured-in-browser note).

The preprod auth.spec.ts:24 'should show OAuth buttons' failure does not share the unit tests' cause: the unit tests were stale, while the page shows buttons only when /api/v2/auth/oauth/urls returns providers (frontend/src/app/auth/signin/page.tsx). The preprod failure remains unexplained and uncarded.
